title: The Number That Decides It Is The One Nobody Can Measure
summary: Scrub the discount rate and watch two projects trade places at 10.03 per cent, then meet a cash flow with two internal rates of return and another, with the same two sign changes, that has none.

sources.title: Brealey, Myers and Allen, Principles of Corporate Finance, chapters 2 and 5
HM Treasury, The Green Book: appraisal and evaluation in central government
Hazen, A new perspective on multiple internal rates of return, The Engineering Economist 48 (2003) 31-51
